> [!CAUTION]
> Daphne (fueled by kingfisher) detected 1 potential secret in files touched by this PR.

<sub>⚪ unverified — the engine could not validate it, it may still be live</sub>

### Found in touched files outside this PR's changes

Daphne scans each touched file in full, so a finding here may predate this PR — open blame to see who introduced the line.

| Secret | File |
|---|---|
| ⚪ DevCycle Server SDK Key | [`test/test_local_client.py:562`](https://github.com/DevCycleHQ/python-server-sdk/blame/b3ffccd66b3f00f8a1a6f65d064c5ea0d2926459/test/test_local_client.py#L562) |


---

### What to do

**If a finding is a real secret** (not a sample, placeholder or test data), **treat it as compromised**. It stopped being confidential the moment it landed in git.

1. **Rotate or revoke it now** at the provider, and update whatever consumes it.
2. **If this branch introduced it, purge it from history.** Deleting the file or force-pushing won't remove it — it stays in every clone and the reflog. Rewrite history with [`git filter-repo`](https://github.com/newren/git-filter-repo), then force-push. See [GitHub: removing sensitive data](https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/keeping-your-account-and-data-secure/removing-sensitive-data-from-a-repository).

Daphne **never blocks merging**, even when its check shows ⚪. Findings that aren't real secrets need no action.

<sub>Questions? → [#dev-help-security](https://dynatrace.enterprise.slack.com/archives/C01NKP8H2PR)</sub>
